title: The west tennis court, through its open gate
caption: For the tennis club (day 4 in the plan). The courts' gate off the courts walk stands open, and the west court with the run-off round it is walked. On the court the camera looks up it and holds the whole court, both sides of the net. Reach it from the sports ground (?place=sports, then east along the courts walk). The clubhouse stays a front.

sections.title: The gate
sections.caption: Before: two mesh leaves shut with a chain and lock. After: the leaves swung in against the inside of the fence, the chain hanging loose off the west post.

sections.title: On the court
sections.caption: The whole court in one frame from the gate and from the net. By the net's west post along the fence: the players' bench, a wire basket of balls on legs, and the score display on its post facing the court.
